artifacts.summary: Confirms Case H's third assertion breaks because its sandbox never installs review-stack-prepare.sh, recommends remedy (a) (retarget to the refusal-arm shape), and rules the adjacent review.state/review.ref assertion still correct against live code -- the /slice ruling's narrowing of milestone-review-handoff.sh has not been dispatched as a task yet.

memory_candidates.content: When a decision record (e.g. specs/decisions/slice-command-one-path-to-review.md) rules a future narrowing of a script's behavior, check specs/state.json for the completed task that implemented the CURRENT behavior and any roadmap_annotation noting the pending revision, rather than assuming the ruling already took effect in the live file. A ruling record builds nothing itself; only a dispatched successor task changes code.

Before choosing between a smaller test-fix remedy and a larger one that builds new fixture coverage for an existing success-arm code path, check whether an accepted decision record already schedules that code path for deletion -- building fixture investment around soon-to-be-removed machinery is wasted effort even if it is technically feasible (a reusable success fixture existed in test-milestone-review-handoff.sh's make_success_fixture_repo()).
